title: ModelCard Exchange Disclosure Record
description: Machine-readable AI model compliance disclosure record. Maps to EU AI Act Annex IV, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001 obligations. v0.1 — community draft. Not legal advice. The schema version is identified by the $id URL and by the schema_version field on each record.

schema_version.description: MCX schema version this record conforms to. For records targeting this schema, must be "0.1.0". Newer schema versions will publish their own const.

disclosure_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this disclosure record. UUID v4 recommended.

model_id.description: Provider-controlled stable identifier for the AI system. Immutable across versions.

model_name.description: Human-readable name of the AI model or system.

version.description: Released version of the AI model this disclosure describes. Semver recommended.

previous_version.description: Previous released version, if this is an update. Used for changelog continuity.

model_family.description: Optional product/model family grouping (for multi-model product lines).

publisher.description: The entity publishing this disclosure record and their relationship to the AI system under the EU AI Act. The publisher may be the Provider (Article 16), Deployer (Article 26), Authorised Representative (Article 22), Importer (Article 23), Distributor (Article 24), or Product Manufacturer (Article 25). The `role` field identifies which. Maps to Annex IV §1(a), Annex V §2.

name.description: Legal name of the publishing organisation.

role.description: The EU AI Act role of the entity publishing this disclosure. Determines which obligations apply. Provider = Article 16; Deployer = Article 26; Authorised Representative = Articles 22/54; Importer = Article 23; Distributor = Article 24; Product Manufacturer = Article 25.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the publisher's primary jurisdiction.

website.description: Official website URL of the publishing organisation.

contact.description: Compliance contact point. Required by Article 13(3)(a) and Annex V §2.

eu_authorised_representative.description: EU representative for non-EU Providers. Required for high-risk AI systems under Article 22 and GPAI models under Article 54. Populated when the publisher (or the Provider on whose behalf the publisher acts) is established outside the EU.

verified_organisation_id.description: Optional MCX Verified Organisation identifier issued after registry verification.

risk_class.description: Top-level EU AI Act classification. Maps to Article 5 (prohibited), Article 6 (high-risk), Article 50 (transparency obligations — informally 'limited risk'), Article 51 (GPAI).

annex_iii_category.description: Annex III high-risk category (1–8) if risk_class = high_risk via Annex III.

annex_i_product_reference.description: Union harmonisation legislation reference if high-risk via product safety (Annex I).

classification_rationale.description: Justification for the assigned risk_class. Required for high-risk and borderline systems (Article 6, Article 7).

model_description.description: General description of the AI system. Annex IV §1(a).

model_summary.description: Optional one-line summary for registry display.

intended_purpose.description: Official intended purpose. Article 3(12), Annex IV §1(a), Article 13(3)(b)(i).

intended_users.description: Expected operators or user types. Article 13(3)(b)(i), Article 14(4)(a).

out_of_scope_use.description: Explicit unsupported or prohibited uses. Article 13(3)(b)(iii), Article 9(2)(b).

foreseeable_misuse.description: Reasonably foreseeable misuse scenarios. Required for high-risk under Article 9(2)(b) and Article 13(3)(b)(iii).

deployment_regions.description: Regions or jurisdictions where the system is deployed. Use ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes or 'EU', 'global', etc.

upstream_dependencies.description: External systems or models relied upon. Annex IV §1(b), Article 25 (value chain).

training_data_description.description: Description of training data. Article 10(2), Annex IV §2(d).

training_data_source.description: Origin of training data. Article 10(2)(b), Article 10(3).

training_time_period.description: Time range represented by training data. Article 10(4).

personal_data_usage.description: Whether personal data is used in training or inference. Article 10(5), GDPR Article 6/9.

sensitive_data_usage.description: Whether special-category personal data is processed. GDPR Article 9.

gdpr_dpia_reference.description: Reference to a Data Protection Impact Assessment, where personal data is processed. GDPR Article 35.

known_data_gaps.description: Known weaknesses, biases, or gaps in training data. Article 10(2)(h).

evaluation_summary.description: Summary of model evaluation. For structured metrics use evaluation_metrics extension. Annex IV §2(g).

evaluation_metrics.description: Structured performance metrics. Recommended for high-risk and GPAI systems.

accuracy_specification.description: Declared accuracy level in instructions for use. Required for high-risk under Article 15(3).

known_limitations.description: Known limitations and failure conditions. Article 13(3)(b)(ii)–(iii), Annex IV §3.

bias_assessment.description: Bias evaluation methodology and results. Required for high-risk under Article 10(2)(f)–(g) and Article 15.

robustness_testing.description: Adversarial and robustness testing. Required for high-risk under Article 15(4).

cybersecurity_controls.description: Security controls and measures. Required for high-risk under Article 15(5), Annex IV §2(i).

human_oversight_measures.description: Human intervention controls. Required for high-risk under Article 14, Annex IV §2(f).

explainability_capabilities.description: Technical capabilities of the system to provide information relevant to explaining its output. Article 13(3)(b)(iv). Where applicable for high-risk systems.

group_specific_performance.description: Performance metrics for specific persons or groups on which the system is intended to be used. Article 13(3)(b)(v). Required when appropriate — particularly for Annex III categories involving persons (credit, employment, justice, law enforcement).

input_data_specifications.description: Specifications for input data at inference time, and any relevant information about training, validation, and testing datasets beyond training_data_description. Article 13(3)(b)(vi). Required when appropriate for high-risk systems.

output_interpretation_guidance.description: Information enabling deployers to interpret outputs and use them appropriately (e.g. confidence scores, decision thresholds, output ranges). Article 13(3)(b)(vii). Where applicable for high-risk systems.

predetermined_changes.description: Changes to the system and its performance predetermined by the provider at the time of initial conformity assessment. Article 13(3)(c). Required for high-risk systems where applicable.

computational_requirements.description: Computational and hardware resources needed to run the AI system. Article 13(3)(e). Required for high-risk systems in instructions for use.

expected_lifetime.description: Expected lifetime of the AI system. Article 13(3)(e). Required for high-risk systems in instructions for use.

maintenance_measures.description: Necessary maintenance and care measures, including frequency, to ensure proper functioning. Article 13(3)(e). Required for high-risk systems in instructions for use.

synthetic_content_disclosure.description: Method for marking AI-generated content. Required for generative systems under Article 50(2).

ai_interaction_disclosure.description: How users are notified they are interacting with AI. Required under Article 50(1) for chatbots and direct user-facing AI.

risk_management_process.description: Ongoing risk management framework. Required for high-risk under Article 9, Annex IV §5.

monitoring_plan.description: Post-market monitoring process. Required for high-risk under Article 72, Annex IV §9.

logging_capabilities.description: Logging and audit trace support. Required for high-risk under Article 12, Article 19, Annex IV §2(c).

technical_documentation_bundle.description: URL or reference to the full Annex IV technical documentation dossier. Article 11.

conformity_assessment_type.description: Type of conformity assessment route used. Article 43, Annex VI (internal control), Annex VII (QMS + technical doc).

ce_marking_status.description: CE conformity status for high-risk systems placed on EU market. Article 48.

eu_database_registration_id.description: EU database registration identifier (Article 49, Article 71, Annex VIII).

foundation_model_flag.description: True if this is a General-Purpose AI model. Article 3(63), Article 51, Article 53.

systemic_risk_flag.description: True if classified as systemic-risk GPAI under Article 51.

gpai_training_data_summary_url.description: Public sufficiently-detailed training data summary. Required for GPAI under Article 53(1)(d).

copyright_policy.description: Copyright and training data policy, including TDM opt-out. Required for GPAI under Article 53(1)(c).

training_compute_summary.description: Summary of compute resources used for training. Required for systemic-risk GPAI under Article 55(1)(b)–(d) and Article 53(1)(a) read with Annex XI.

lifecycle_status.description: Current operational status of the AI system.

published_at.description: Timestamp this disclosure record was first published.

last_updated_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this disclosure record.

incidents.description: Recorded serious incidents under Article 73. Each incident references a separate report.

attestation.description: Formal attestation by a named individual that this disclosure is accurate to the best of their knowledge. The MCX registry does not certify content accuracy — the attestor is accountable.

attestor_name.description: Full name of the natural person attesting.

attestor_role.description: Role of the attestor within the publishing organisation (e.g. Chief Compliance Officer).

attestation_status.description: Type of attestation. self_attested = vendor only. third_party_verified = independent reviewer named. notified_body = formal conformity assessment by a Notified Body.

third_party_verifier.description: Name of independent verifier, if attestation_status = third_party_verified.

framework_mappings.description: Cross-references to other regulatory and assurance frameworks this disclosure satisfies. Each entry lists framework-specific control or subcategory IDs that map to fields in this record.

nist_ai_rmf.description: NIST AI Risk Management Framework subcategory references (e.g. GOVERN-1.1, MAP-2.3).

deployment_context.description: The specific operational environment, user population, and scope of actual use. Article 26(1)–(2). Distinct from the Provider's intended_use_context — this captures what the system is being used for in practice, not what it was designed for.

fundamental_rights_impact_assessment_ref.description: Reference (URL or document ID) to the fundamental rights impact assessment conducted before putting the system into use. Article 27. Conditionally required when publisher.role = 'deployer' AND risk_class = 'high_risk'. Article 27 applies to deployers that are bodies governed by public law or private entities providing public services, and to deployers of high-risk systems under Annex III point 5(b) and (c).

intended_use_monitoring.description: The deployer's arrangements for monitoring system performance and intervening when behaviour deviates from intended use, including human oversight assignments and escalation procedures. Article 26(5).
